_title: A claim in the app, before and after verifying
_about: A claim from a real pipeline run (the hosted-SaaS demo,
data/processed/runs/demo_saas.json). Stage 2 (the LLM) writes 'text', the 'clause_id' it
relies on and an exact 'quote'. Then 'quote_found' checks the quote really is in that
clause, and the verifier reads the full 'clause_text' with the claim (a clause-claim pair)
and gives the 'nli' scores; the highest sets 'status'. The LLM never grades its own claim.
